text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
"—Now then, that's all for today's 
assignment. I want each of you to think 
about your own strengths. It might be a 
good idea to ask those around you as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: My strong points, huh...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—And that's what happened. What do you 
think it is, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just a brief summary is fine, you 
know? It'll be more than helpful enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't seem to be worried about 
anything. In that case, I'll answer with 
whatever comes to mind first. When it 
comes to her good points...
choice_data_list: Being so popular and beloved by everyone.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Popular... Hmm, hehehe... Hearing you say 
it out loud feels a little ticklish, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has always been popular since she was 
young. There wasn't a single person in the 
neighborhood who didn't know Buena Vista. 
Whenever we walked together, people would 
call out to her from everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's just because everyone is so kind. 
So many people have taken care of me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the academy, there's always someone 
around her. Classmates, upperclassmen, 
underclassmen, teachers, instructors, even 
the cafeteria staff... She's super 
popular!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Besides, everyone at the academy is so 
nice. It's always lively and fun every 
day.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, does that mean I'm "blessed with good 
people"? Maybe I'm just lucky.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we all baked sweets together 
yesterday, and tonight we're having a card 
tournament in the dorm. And then, 
tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking... that all we ever 
talk about together is training...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even though we finally reunited... Our 
private plans have decreased... compared 
to before, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She awkwardly brought it up. Once she said 
it, I realized. Indeed... that might be 
true.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I know you're busy. And that 
the races come first...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we can't go to each other's rooms 
like we used to, and...”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No academy, no races, nothing like that... 
I just miss those ordinary, carefree 
moments.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I gave the race my all so I 
didn't notice, but now that I think about 
it, it feels a little lonely.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know. Why don't we go hang out 
somewhere for the whole day next time?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what do you say? If you're okay with 
it, I'd love to just chat about random 
everyday things with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We promised to go on a short trip once the 
racing schedule settled down. Seeing her 
look so happy warmed my heart.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: A "strong core"... I see!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Gentil-san's said that to me 
before, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Having guts"... was what it said.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But you see... if I really am 
strong, the reason I could become this way 
must be...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm sure it's all thanks to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Because you know, don't you? Just how 
much of a crybaby I was when I was 
little..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'd always chase after you... and cry 
whenever we were apart...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Gradually... maybe the desire to catch up 
started to grow within me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Protecting me, studying hard... Even when 
you chose your path in life and decided to 
become a Trainer... you did it for me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's because I... wanted to follow someone 
like you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That goes... for me as well. Thinking of 
Buena Vista made me stronger. I could 
overcome any hardship.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
......Ehehe. Maybe that was a bit of an 
exaggeration? But it's the truth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looked a little embarrassed as she 
said that. Yet deep within her eyes, I 
could still see a supple inner strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought, but I hesitated to say it 
out loud."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if you tell me that, it won't be of 
any help. I can't exactly write "My 
strength is having a pure heart" on my 
assignment...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Did you just stop yourself from saying 
something...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufufu! I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be something that might trouble 
me...?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Chuckle... Then... let me guess?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like something you would say, 
Trainer... doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hrrrrrmmm... Mghhh...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah! How about 'Full of weird trivia'?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whenever we watched quiz shows together 
and I got the answer right, you'd look so 
surprised and ask, "Where on earth did you 
learn that?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Then... 'easily moved'...? Which is 
another way of saying 'crybaby.'

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Heeeyyy, what could it be...? Something 
good about me that's a bit hard to say...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since she isn't aware of it, there's no 
way she could guess. Buena Vista racked 
her brain, groaning in thought.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her innocence is an unmatched virtue. I 
felt a bit frustrated that I couldn't 
properly convey that to her—
